## 2. Core Creative Disciplines

### A. Cinematic Post-Production & Video Editing
- **Editorial Pacing & Rhythm**: Frame-accurate rhythm cuts synchronizing visual transients with musical cadence and ambient soundscapes.
- **Color Grading**: Professional color grading in DaVinci Resolve Studio utilizing calibrated color spaces (ACES, Rec.709, DaVinci Wide Gamut), custom film emulations, split toning, and highlight rolloff sculpting.
- **Sound Design & Foley**: Layered Foley, sub-bass impacts, ambient textures, audio transitions, and stem mixing to build immersive sonic depth.
- **Short-Form Content**: Crafting high-retention vertical videos (9:16 Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) designed for hook-rate optimization, dynamic motion graphics, and narrative continuity.

### B. UI/UX & Design Systems
- **Grid Systems**: Strict mathematical layout foundations (12-column Swiss grids, golden ratio proportions, fluid clamp typography).
- **Tactile UI Elements**: Skeuomorphic and neo-tactile interaction patterns, glassmorphism, micro-grain textures, and physical hardware metaphors (e.g. iPod click wheels, audio dials).
- **Typography**: Editorial typography hierarchy pairing grotesque display typefaces with legibility-optimized body fonts (SF Pro, Figtree, Fraunces, Outfit, Inter).

### C. Creative Technology & Software Engineering
- **Modern Web**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Turbopack, Tailwind CSS, Vanilla CSS Modules.
- **Graphics & Shaders**: WebGL, GLSL fragment shaders, procedural particle canvases, and CSS transforms.
- **AI Integration**: Prompt engineering, autonomous AI agent pipelines, and automated content workflows.

**Q: Who is Rishabh Naik?**

**Q: What video editing software does Rishabh Naik use?**
A: Rishabh primary uses DaVinci Resolve Studio for precision editing, color grading, and finishing, alongside Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects for motion graphics.

**Q: What are Rishabh Naik's primary development skills?**
A: Rishabh specializes in Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, CSS Modules, performance optimization, and creative technology including procedural graphics and WebGL shaders.
